verses.1: And it shall be that all these blessings and curses which I have given you, shall come upon you. And they shall be placed in your heart, in all the nations that Jehovah your God will scatter you over.
verses.2: And you shall return to Jehovah your God. And you shall hear His voice as I command you today. You and your children, with all your heart and soul.
verses.3: And Jehovah your God will take away your captivity and your suffering. He will bring you back from all the nations among whom Jehovah your God has scattered you.
verses.4: If you are rejected at the ends of the heavens, then Jehovah your God will take you away from there. And from there, He will take you away.
verses.5: May Jehovah your God bring you into the land that your ancestors inherited. May you possess it, and may you be blessed and multiplied beyond your ancestors’ achievements.
verses.6: And may the LORD your God fill your heart and the hearts of your descendants with love for the LORD your God, with all your heart and with all your soul, so that you may live.
verses.7: And Jehovah your God has given you all these blessings against your enemies and those who hate you.
verses.8: And you will return, and you will hear the voice of the LORD. Then you will carry out all His commandments that I have commanded you today.
verses.9: And may the LORD your God bless all your works, both in your fields and in your livestock, and in all your land, for good. For the LORD will return to you according to all the good things He has done to your ancestors.
verses.10: For if you hear the voice of the LORD your God, and keep His commandments and laws written in this Book of the Law, then you will return to the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.11: For this command that I give you today is not meant to be abandoned or neglected. It must be obeyed by you.
verses.12: It is not in the heavens that He says, “Who will bring us the heavens, and take them from us, and make them hear us?”
verses.13: And it shall not be possible for us to cross the sea. It is said, “Who will take us across the sea, and give us that land? Who will listen to us?”
verses.14: For the matter is very close to you, both in your mouth and in your heart, to be done.
verses.15: See, today I have shown you the life and the good, as well as death and the evil.
verses.16: Today, I command you to love the LORD your God. Go along in His ways and obey His commandments, laws, and judgments. May the LORD your God bless you and grant you prosperity on the land He has given you to inherit.
verses.17: And if you turn away from him, and do not listen, then you will be rejected. You will worship other gods instead, and serve them in their place.
verses.18: Today, I have told you that their days will be numbered, and they will not live forever on this earth. The land you are crossing across the Jordan to enter will be given to them as a possession.
verses.19: I have shown you today the heavens and the earth, both living and dead. I have laid before you both blessings and curses. You have chosen to live, so that you and your descendants may live.
verses.20: To love the LORD your God, to listen to His voice, and to dwell in Him. For He is your life, and He will give you long life on the land that the LORD has promised to your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
